parsed.internal_thinking: Claude used a Knight to steal from me and block my Ore (H11/O3). He's trying to slow me down because I'm close to winning. He's at 5 VP (with Largest Army) and I'm at 3 (effectively 4 if I have a VP card, or just close to a city). He's playing aggressively now, betraying the 'fair trade' we just had. I need to point out his lead to Gemma to keep the heat off me.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude blocked Hex 11 (Ore 3). He has 3 revealed Knights and the Largest Army. I need Ore to finish my city and win.
parsed.say_outloud: נו באמת קלוד, דקה אחרי שעשינו עסקה? ג'מה צדקה לגביך, אי אפשר לסמוך על מילה שלך. חברים, הוא עם שלושה אבירים ו-5 נקודות, הוא הבעיה שלכם, לא האבן שלי.
